location: Western Forests — Old-growth elven forests west of the fort.

cast.standsTo: tends the pass and asks something in return for coming in
trades what they know, for a price
holds the forest pledges and will contest anything moved

bible.goal: to recruit the keeper of the Harrowgate winter feeder so she will join the company and secure their winter supply line
bible.stakeIfLost: If the feeder stops, the lane closes, and the fort goes into winter with what is already inside the walls.

relevantLore.name: Harrowgate Pass
relevantLore.blurb: a narrow winter gap with iron posts and a single feeding plinth at its throat.

arcStep: Travel to the beekeepers' clearings to ask who keeps Harrowgate Pass fed
pay: the agreed coin, and what the road turns up
stepFriction: The beekeepers keep their stores close and want paying before they answer.
arrival: word came down the low road with the last carts before the snow
